description: Explains one investing term or Acubic setting in plain language (a metric such as P/E or maximum drawdown, a filter, ranking or weighting method, risk level, rebalance or backtest term): its meaning, how Acubic uses it, default, caveats and its page. Use it whenever the user asks what a term means, so the answer matches how Acubic computes it. It does not say what a person should choose. For articles, pricing or the FAQ use acubic_search_knowledge.

kind.description: Limit to one kind of term.

topic.description: A term or option id, e.g. 'P/E ratio', 'pe', 'cap_rank_10', 'walk-forward'.

name: acubic_explain

content_locale.description: Language of the wording: en for now.

default.description: What Acubic uses when nothing is chosen, per experience level where it differs.

suggestions.description: Close terms when nothing matches exactly.

title: Explain a term or setting
